use default

sum_of_squares(values: Collections.Iterable[double]) -> double =>
    values
        |> map(v => v * v)
        |> reduce(0.0, (running, square) => running + square)

write_line("{sum_of_squares([3.0, 1.0, 4.0, 1.0, 5.0, 9.0])}")
write_line("{sum_of_squares([])}")

use default

sum_of_squares(values: Collections.Iterable[double]) -> double =>
    values
        |> map(v => v * v)
        |> reduce(0.0, (running, square) => running + square)

write_line("{sum_of_squares([3.0, 1.0, 4.0, 1.0, 5.0, 9.0])}")
write_line("{sum_of_squares([])}")
